title: 新游汇总：Football Manager、Dispatch、The Traitors、UnGodly、Dr. Seuss等
content:
New game digest: Football Manager, Dispatch, The Traitors, UnGodly, Dr. Seuss and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Here every Friday you’ll find the latest global releases, game dates, new soft launches and everything in between.
This column is sponsored by
Kohort
.
Plug in your MMP and
Ktrl will tell you what to scale by this afternoon
. 20-minute setup, no engineering required.
FM27 Touch (Sega)
FM27 Touch
launches on Apple Arcade
on November 10 for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. The football management sim lets players continue saves from past titles and carry their progress across devices via the cloud. The existing FM26 Touch page on the App Store will update to FM27 Touch automatically on launch day.
Dispatch (AdHoc Studio)
Narrative game
Dispatch is coming to Android and iOS
on December 9, with support for Google Play Games on PC. The mobile version is rebuilt for touch and vertical play, with the first four episodes free and the full game unlocking for $19.99. Pre-registration on Google Play and pre-orders on the App Store will open soon. AdHoc says the game has passed 5m players since its launch a year ago.
The Traitors: Interactive Game (Fusebox Games)
Fusebox Games released
The Traitors: Interactive Game
on iOS and Android worldwide earlier this month, in partnership with All3Media International and Banijay Rights. The interactive fiction game is based on the reality TV format. Fusebox, a UK studio owned by Nazara Technologies, has previously brought Love Island and Big Brother to mobile.
UnGodly (Azra)
Free-to-play dark fantasy action RPG UnGodly
launches globally on November 11
on the App Store and Google Play. It will be playable on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Android and Google Play Games for PC, with the Galaxy Store and One Store following in December. It is the first game from Azra Games, which was founded by Mark Otero, a former EA and BioWare executive known for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes.
Dr. Seuss: Learn & Play (Be The Monster)
Educational subscription app
Dr. Seuss: Learn & Play
is out now on iPhone and iPad, with more than 100 learning games inspired by 22 Dr. Seuss books for children aged 2 to 8. The English-language app is made under licence from Dr. Seuss Enterprises. It is the first release from Be The Monster, which was founded by Frosty Pop’s Faisal Sethi and his daughter Neko. The app costs $7.99 a month or $64.99 a year in the US, after a 7-day free trial.
The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition (Blue Brain Games)
Puzzle adventure
The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
is out now on iOS and Android, priced at $6.99, €6.99 and £6.99. Set in Nikola Tesla’s abandoned Wardenclyffe facility, it comes from the studio behind The House of Da Vinci series. A single App Store purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Astrae Oratio (NC)
Published by NC and developed by Dynamis One, anime RPG Astrae Oratio is due on iOS and Android in 2027, with a PC release to follow. NC
says
players logged nearly 80,000 hours in its five-day closed beta, which ran from October 2 to October 6.
The Operator (Ateo)
Mystery puzzle adventure
The Operator is now available
on iOS and Android worldwide. Ateo says it is its first try before you buy title on mobile.
Chicken vs Aliens (Naphora)
Naphora’s free-to-play survivor game
Chicken vs Aliens
has been in worldwide soft launch on Google Play since October 17, with iOS to follow after App Store review. Players control one chicken against waves of aliens, using auto-combat and stacking upgrade cards. It is the fourth of six soft launches the Riyadh studio planned for 2026.
